# MSSQL Extension for VS Code: Local Azure SQL Database Provisioning, Query Performance Dashboard, and more

## What Changed

A local database is a useful starting point, but deploying it and understanding how queries behave should fit into the same development workflow. The MSSQL extension for VS Code v1.48 brings three new public previews: Azure SQL Database local container provisioning, a local-to-cloud deployment wizard, and the Query Performance Dashboard.
